requirements.title: Opening a workspace
requirements.rationale: Every scenario starts from a workspace whose root was resolved exactly once and cannot be forged.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open(root, opts) with a non-empty root that exists
criteria.action: return a *Workspace whose Root() is the absolute path of root with every symlink resolved
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Abs(root))

setup: a temp directory T and a symlink L that points at T
check.pseudocode: ws, err = Open(L, Options{}); assert err == nil; assert ws.Root() == EvalSymlinks(T)

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open with an empty root
criteria.action: use the process working directory as the root, resolved as in 20-REQ-1.1
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals the symlink-resolved os.Getwd()

setup: the process working directory is a temp directory reached through a symlink
check.pseudocode: t.Chdir(L); ws,_ = Open("", Options{}); assert ws.Root() == EvalSymlinks(Getwd())

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open with a root that does not exist
criteria.action: keep the root in its lexical absolute form and report no error
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals filepath.Abs(root)

setup: a path P under a temp directory that does not exist
check.pseudocode: ws, err = Open(P, Options{}); assert err == nil; assert ws.Root() == Abs(P); assert !exists(P)

criteria.condition: the process working directory or the absolute form of root cannot be determined
criteria.action: return no workspace and the underlying error
criteria.contract: (nil, non-nil error)

setup: the process working directory has been removed after chdir into it (test skipped on platforms where os.Getwd still succeeds)
check.pseudocode: t.Chdir(d); os.Remove(d); ws, err = Open("", Options{}); assert ws == nil; assert err != nil

criteria.action: read no ignore file and start no subprocess during Open
criteria.contract: the fake git recorded zero invocations; the Getenv, Home and GitConfig hooks were called zero times; the .gitignore file was not opened (no access recorded)

setup: a root containing a .gitignore that is a directory-unreadable trap and a fake `git` first on PATH that records every invocation
IgnoreOptions whose Getenv, Home and GitConfig hooks count their calls
check.pseudocode: ws,_ = Open(root, Options{Ignore: counting}); assert gitCalls == 0; assert hookCalls == 0

criteria.action: declare Workspace with no exported fields and Options with exactly one field, Ignore of type IgnoreOptions, whose zero value reads the real ignore environment including global excludes
criteria.contract: Workspace has zero exported fields; Options has exactly one field named Ignore of type IgnoreOptions; Open with the zero Options succeeds and does not set any hook (zero IgnoreOptions)

setup: the workspace package
check.pseudocode: assert NumExportedFields(Workspace) == 0; assert Options.NumField()==1 && Field(0).Name=="Ignore" && Type==IgnoreOptions

criteria.action: for any number of goroutines calling Root, Resolve, Rel, CheckWriteTarget, Ignore, Walk and Ignored on one *Workspace concurrently, return the same results as sequential calls and report no data race under go test -race
criteria.contract: every goroutine's result equals the result of the same call made sequentially; the race detector reports no race

setup: one *Workspace over a tree with nested .gitignore files, run under go test -race
check.pseudocode: seq = map(calls, run); parallel(N, calls); assert results == seq

requirements.title: Containment and normalization move unchanged
requirements.rationale: The move is about placement; the security boundary must behave exactly as the tools version did.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Resolve(p) with a path that resolves inside the root
criteria.action: normalize p before canonicalizing it, join a relative result to Root(), resolve symlinks against the deepest existing ancestor, follow dangling links to their targets, and compare containment segment by segment
criteria.contract: (contained absolute path, nil)

setup: a workspace root with an inside symlink to an inside directory, a dangling symlink whose target is inside, and a sibling directory named root+"-evil"
check.pseudocode: assert Resolve("a/b.txt") == root+"/a/b.txt"; assert errors.Is(Resolve(root+"-evil/x"), ErrPathNotAllowed)

criteria.condition: Resolve or CheckWriteTarget is given a path whose resolved target lies outside the root, including a path made of a component swapped for an outward symlink after Resolve (CheckWriteTarget re-resolves the whole path)
criteria.action: refuse the path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed whose text starts with "workspace: path_not_allowed", names the root, and ends with "; use a path inside the workspace (a relative path is resolved against the root)"

setup: a workspace root R, a symlink R/out -> outside directory, and an in-root directory D that is swapped for an outward symlink after Resolve
check.pseudocode: err = Resolve("out/f"); assert Is(err, ErrPathNotAllowed); assert HasPrefix(err.Error(), "workspace: path_not_allowed"); assert HasSuffix(err.Error(), nextStep)

criteria.condition: Normalize or Resolve is given an empty path, a path containing a NUL byte, a non-local file:// URL, `~user` for an unknown user, or a symlink chain longer than 40 hops
criteria.action: refuse the path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathMalformed whose text starts with "workspace: path_malformed"

setup: a workspace and the unknown user name `no-such-user-xyz`
check.pseudocode: for p in bad: err = Resolve(p); assert Is(err, ErrPathMalformed); assert HasPrefix(err.Error(), "workspace: path_malformed")

criteria.condition: a path starting with `~` or `~/` is normalized while the home directory cannot be resolved
criteria.action: refuse the path instead of falling back to a relative path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrNoHome whose text starts with "workspace: home directory could not be resolved"

setup: HOME and the platform home variables unset so os.UserHomeDir fails
check.pseudocode: unsetenv(HOME); _, err = Normalize("~/x"); assert Is(err, ErrNoHome)

criteria.condition: Normalize is given `~`, `~/x`, `~user/x`, `@x` or a quoted path
criteria.action: expand the home directory or the named user's home, strip the leading `@` and the quotes, and return the rewritten path
criteria.contract: (rewritten path, nil), identical to the string tools.Normalize returned before this change

setup: HOME set to a temp directory H and the current user known
check.pseudocode: assert Normalize("~/x") == (H+"/x", nil); assert Normalize("@x") == ("x", nil)

criteria.action: make Rel(abs) return abs relative to Root() when abs lies under the root and return abs unchanged otherwise, never failing
criteria.contract: R/a/b gives "a/b"; outside paths are returned unchanged; the call never panics or reports an error

setup: a workspace root R
check.pseudocode: assert Rel(R+"/a/b")=="a/b"; assert Rel("/elsewhere")=="/elsewhere"

criteria.condition: a built-in file tool receives a path that the workspace refuses as outside the root
criteria.action: fail the tool call without touching the file
criteria.contract: core.ErrResult with result code "path_not_allowed" and the workspace error text

setup: tools.For over a workspace in a temp dir, and an outside file O with known content
check.pseudocode: r = call(write_file, {path:O, content:"x"}); assert r.IsError && r.Code=="path_not_allowed"; assert read(O)==orig

requirements.title: The workspace owns its ignore rules
requirements.rationale: Ignore configuration is given once, and the git subprocess it may need is paid at most once per workspace.

criteria.action: declare IgnoreOptions with fields Getenv func(string) string, Home func() (string, error) and GitConfig func() string, where a nil GitConfig runs `git config --path --get core.excludesFile`, and make NoGlobalExcludes() return options whose global layer is empty
criteria.contract: NoGlobalExcludes() returns IgnoreOptions whose GitConfig returns ""

setup: the workspace package
check.pseudocode: assert NoGlobalExcludes().GitConfig() == ""

criteria.action: run at most one core.excludesFile lookup per workspace over its lifetime, including when several goroutines first use its rules at once, and run none before the rules are first used
criteria.contract: the count is 0 after Open; the count is exactly 1 after the concurrent first use; the count stays 1 after further walks and Ignored calls

setup: a workspace opened with a counting GitConfig hook
check.pseudocode: Open(...); assert n==0; parallel(32, ()=>Ignored("a",false)); assert n==1

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Ignore()
criteria.action: return the workspace's IgnoreOptions with GitConfig memoized, so that passing them on (for example to sandbox.LocalDir.Ignore) and using them runs no further lookup
criteria.contract: IgnoreOptions whose GitConfig returns the same value on every call and invokes the underlying lookup at most once

setup: a workspace opened with a counting GitConfig hook returning a path P
check.pseudocode: o = ws.Ignore(); assert o.GitConfig()==P && o.GitConfig()==P; assert n<=1; ws2=Open(root,Options{Ignore:o}); use(ws2); assert n<=1

criteria.action: apply ignore sources from lowest precedence: the global excludes file, `.git/info/exclude`, then `.gitignore` files from the scan root down, with the last matching pattern winning so that a `!` pattern re-includes
criteria.contract: a.log is ignored by the global layer; keep.log is re-included by the repository exclude file; sub/important.log is re-included by the later .gitignore; build and sub/x.tmp are ignored, plain.txt is not; Walk visits exactly the entries Ignored reports as not ignored

setup: a global excludes file ignoring *.log, .git/info/exclude ignoring !keep.log, a root .gitignore ignoring build/ and a sub/.gitignore with `!important.log` and `*.tmp`
check.pseudocode: assert Ignored("a.log",false) && !Ignored("keep.log",false) && !Ignored("sub/important.log",false)

criteria.action: start a new ignore root at every directory containing `.git`, always ignore any path with a `.git` segment, and never read `.ignore` files as a source
criteria.contract: sub/repo/f.dat is not ignored because the root .gitignore stops applying at the repository boundary; any path with a .git segment is ignored even with a `!.git` pattern; a.txt is not ignored because .ignore is not read; Walk with IncludeHidden never calls fn for a .git path

setup: root .gitignore ignoring *.dat, a nested repository dir sub/repo with its own .git and no .gitignore, and a root .ignore file containing *.txt
check.pseudocode: assert !Ignored("sub/repo/f.dat",false); assert Ignored(".git/config",false); assert !Ignored("a.txt",false)

requirements.title: Walking a workspace
requirements.rationale: One walk with the workspace's rules replaces tools.Walk and its per-call ignore options.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Walk(ctx, sub, opts, fn) with sub equal to "" or "." (the root), a relative path (joined to the root) or an absolute path, that after cleaning lies within the root segment by segment
criteria.action: call fn for every entry under sub that the workspace's rules do not exclude, with rel slash-separated and relative to sub, and with the ignore engine rooted at sub so that .gitignore files above sub do not apply while the global layer and `.git/info/exclude` do
criteria.contract: nil error after all calls; the visited set equals what tools.Walk visited before this change for the same tree and options

setup: a tree with a root .gitignore ignoring *.gen, sub/ with no .gitignore, a global excludes file ignoring *.glob and .git/info/exclude ignoring *.excl
check.pseudocode: Walk(ctx,"sub",WalkOptions{},collect); assert "x.gen" in got && "y.glob" !in got && "z.excl" !in got

criteria.condition: sub lies outside the root after cleaning, or the receiver is nil
criteria.action: return before calling fn
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed; fn is called zero times

setup: a workspace over R, a sibling directory R+"-evil", and a nil *Workspace
check.pseudocode: calls=0; err = Walk(ctx,"../x",WalkOptions{},fn); assert Is(err,ErrPathNotAllowed) && calls==0

criteria.action: during Walk, skip dot-prefixed entries unless opts.IncludeHidden is set, not follow symlinks, skip unreadable entries without error, and check sub lexically without normalizing or symlink-resolving it
criteria.contract: an unreadable entry yields no fn call for it and Walk still returns nil

setup: a tree with .hidden/f, a symlink to an outside directory, an unreadable directory (skipped on platforms where chmod 000 is not enforced) and a symlink dir inside the root used as sub
check.pseudocode: assert ".hidden" !in walk(false); assert ".hidden" in walk(true); assert err==nil

criteria.condition: Walk is given a sub that does not exist or that names a regular file
criteria.action: make no calls to fn
criteria.contract: nil error

setup: a workspace with a regular file a.txt and no directory missing/
check.pseudocode: assert Walk(ctx,"missing",o,fn)==nil && calls==0; assert Walk(ctx,"a.txt",o,fn)==nil && calls==0

criteria.condition: ctx is cancelled or past its deadline while Walk runs
criteria.action: stop at the next entry without calling fn for it
criteria.contract: returns ctx.Err()

setup: a tree of 100 files and a context cancelled by fn on the 3rd call, plus a context whose deadline has already passed
check.pseudocode: err = Walk(cctx,"",o,fn); assert err==context.Canceled && calls==3

criteria.condition: fn returns an error
criteria.action: skip the directory on filepath.SkipDir, stop without error on filepath.SkipAll, and stop on any other error
criteria.contract: nil for SkipDir and SkipAll; the error fn returned otherwise

setup: a tree with directories d1/ and d2/, each holding files
check.pseudocode: assert Walk(...SkipDir...)==nil && "d1/f" !in got; assert Walk(...E...)==E

criteria.action: declare WalkOptions with exactly one field, IncludeHidden bool, and always apply the workspace's own ignore rules in Walk
criteria.contract: WalkOptions has exactly one field, IncludeHidden of type bool; x.secret is never visited by Walk with either IncludeHidden value

setup: a workspace opened with Options.Ignore whose GitConfig names a global excludes file ignoring *.secret
check.pseudocode: assert WalkOptions.NumField()==1; assert "x.secret" !in walk(true)

requirements.title: Asking whether a path is ignored
requirements.rationale: Callers that filter candidate files (such as the index-candidate filter) need the same answer a root walk gives, without walking.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Ignored(rel, isDir) with a workspace-relative path using either separator
criteria.action: report whether rel or any ancestor directory of rel is excluded, matching each ancestor against the ignore files of the directories above it loaded from the root down and honouring nested-repository boundaries
criteria.contract: true when rel or an ancestor is excluded, false otherwise

setup: root .gitignore `vendor/`, a/.gitignore `*.o` and `!keep.o`, nested repository a/repo/ with .git, and the workspace root
check.pseudocode: assert Ignored("vendor/x/y.go",false); assert Ignored("a/b.o",false)==Ignored("a\\b.o",false)

criteria.condition: Ignored is given a rel containing a `.git` segment
criteria.action: report the path as ignored
criteria.contract: true

setup: a workspace with no ignore files
check.pseudocode: assert Ignored("a/.git/config",false); assert !Ignored("",true) && !Ignored(".",true)

criteria.condition: Ignored is given "" or "."
criteria.action: report the root as not ignored
criteria.contract: false

criteria.condition: Ignored is given an absolute path or a path that escapes the root after cleaning
criteria.action: fail closed
criteria.contract: true

setup: a workspace over R
check.pseudocode: for p in [R+"/a", "/etc/passwd", "../x", "a/../../x"]: assert Ignored(p,false)==true

criteria.action: not report a dot-prefixed name as ignored on account of its leading dot
criteria.contract: each returns false

setup: a workspace whose rules do not mention .env or .config
check.pseudocode: assert !Ignored(".env",false) && !Ignored(".config/app.toml",false)

criteria.action: read the .gitignore files of rel's ancestor directories and the repository exclude files on every Ignored call and keep no cache between calls, so a .gitignore edited between two calls changes the second answer
criteria.contract: the first call returns true; the second returns false; the third returns true

setup: a workspace over a tree with a/.gitignore containing `*.x` and no other rules
check.pseudocode: assert Ignored(p)==true; write(gitignore,""); assert Ignored(p)==false; write(exclude,"*.x"); assert Ignored(p)==true

criteria.action: for any tree without unreadable entries, including nested .gitignore files, negations and nested repositories, make the set of entries visited by ws.Walk(ctx, "", WalkOptions{IncludeHidden: true}, fn) equal the set of filepath.WalkDir entries under the root for which Ignored(rel, d.IsDir()) is false
criteria.contract: the set of rel paths Walk visits equals the set of WalkDir entries (excluding the root itself) with Ignored(rel, d.IsDir()) == false

setup: a randomly generated tree without unreadable entries, with nested .gitignore files, negations, nested repositories (.git dirs) and hidden entries, opened with NoGlobalExcludes()
check.pseudocode: for tree in gen_trees(): visited = walkSet(ws); expected = {rel for rel,d in WalkDir(root) if rel!="." && !ws.Ignored(rel,d.IsDir())}; assert visited == expected

requirements.title: Tools are built for a workspace
requirements.rationale: The workspace becomes an argument instead of an option, and every tool walk uses its rules.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes tools.For(ws, opts) with a non-nil workspace and no Index
criteria.action: return read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol, find_references, execute and run_command in that order, with names, descriptions, input and output schemas, guidelines and execution modes byte-identical to what tools.All returned before this change
criteria.contract: ([]core.Tool of length 11, nil)

setup: a workspace opened in a temp dir and definitions recorded from the pre-change tools.All stored under testdata
check.pseudocode: ts,err = For(ws, Options{}); assert names(ts)==want; assert marshal(ts)==recorded

criteria.action: for every tool tools.For returns, produce a sandbox/internal/tooldigest digest equal to the digest of the same tool before this change
criteria.contract: each digest equals the recorded pre-change digest

setup: the digests of the eleven tools recorded before this change in sandbox/internal/tooldigest test data
check.pseudocode: for t in For(ws,Options{}): assert Digest(t) == recorded[t.Name]

criteria.condition: opts.Index is set
criteria.action: append Index.Tools() after the eleven built-ins and fail with today's duplicate-name error when an index tool reuses a name
criteria.contract: (built-ins followed by index tools, nil), or (nil, duplicate-name error)

setup: a stub tools.Index whose Tools() returns one tool named idx_search, and another whose Tools() returns a tool named read_file
check.pseudocode: ts,err = For(ws, Options{Index: idx}); assert ts[11].Name=="idx_search"

criteria.condition: tools.For is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return no tools and not fall back to the working directory
criteria.contract: (nil, error whose text names the missing workspace)

setup: the process working directory is a valid directory
check.pseudocode: ts, err = For(nil, Options{}); assert ts==nil; assert Contains(err.Error(),"workspace")

criteria.action: declare tools.Options with SpillDir, DisableSpill, Env, Symbols and Index and today's defaults and without Workspace or Ignore fields, derive the default spill directory from a hash of ws.Root() so the same root yields the same directory, and keep the individual tool constructors unexported
criteria.contract: Options has exactly SpillDir, DisableSpill, Env, Symbols and Index; the same root gives the same default spill directory and a different root gives a different one, equal to defaultSpillDir(hash of ws.Root()); no exported identifier of tools is an individual tool constructor

setup: two workspaces opened at the same root and one at another root
check.pseudocode: assert fields(Options)==[SpillDir,DisableSpill,Env,Symbols,Index]; assert spill(ws1)==spill(ws2)!=spill(ws3)

criteria.action: run execute and run_command with ws.Root() as their working directory
criteria.contract: both outputs equal ws.Root() (symlink-resolved R)

setup: tools.For over a workspace at a temp dir R whose process working directory differs
check.pseudocode: assert trim(call(execute,{command:"pwd"}).text)==ws.Root()

criteria.action: make every directory walk the tools perform (find_files, search_files, the symbol-table build and refresh, the reference engine's Go package load and candidate scan, and the filter over an index's candidate files) go through ws.Walk or ws.Ignored with the workspace's ignore rules
criteria.contract: none of them returns or reads secret_a.go; none returns a/b.go (nested .gitignore honoured, including by the index-candidate filter); each walk was made through ws.Walk or ws.Ignored (test seam records the calls), none through the real environment

setup: a workspace opened with IgnoreOptions whose GitConfig points at a global excludes file ignoring secret_*, and a Go tree containing secret_a.go, a nested a/.gitignore ignoring b.go, and ordinary files
an index stub whose candidate set includes secret_a.go and a/b.go
check.pseudocode: for tool in tools: assert "secret_a.go" !in output(tool) && "a/b.go" !in output(tool)

criteria.action: run at most one core.excludesFile lookup across all walks made by a tool set built from one workspace
criteria.contract: the hook ran exactly once in total

setup: a workspace opened with a counting GitConfig hook and tools.For over it
check.pseudocode: run all; assert n==1

requirements.title: References and the search entry points
requirements.rationale: The reference engine moves off the containment type, and the root-path search functions keep their shape.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes tools.References(ctx, ws, target, opts) with a non-nil workspace
criteria.action: run one reference pass bounded by the default SymbolOptions, with no reference cache and no index
criteria.contract: (ReferenceResult, nil) equal to what (*tools.Workspace).References returned before this change for the same tree and target

setup: a small Go module in a temp dir with a declaration and three reference sites, and the site list recorded from the pre-change (*Workspace).References
check.pseudocode: res, err = References(ctx, ws, target, ReferenceOptions{}); assert err==nil && res==recorded

criteria.condition: tools.References is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return without searching
criteria.contract: (empty ReferenceResult, non-nil error)

setup: a valid target declaration
check.pseudocode: res, err = References(ctx, nil, t, o); assert res.IsZero() && err!=nil

criteria.condition: tools.References is called with an opts.Path outside the workspace
criteria.action: return without searching
criteria.contract: (empty ReferenceResult, error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed)

setup: a workspace over R and an outside directory O
check.pseudocode: res, err = References(ctx, ws, t, ReferenceOptions{Path:O}); assert Is(err, workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed) && res.IsZero()

criteria.condition: the context passed to tools.References is cancelled
criteria.action: stop the pass
criteria.contract: returns the context's error

setup: a Go tree and an already-cancelled context
check.pseudocode: cancel(); _, err = References(ctx, ws, t, o); assert err == context.Canceled

criteria.action: keep tools.Search(ctx, root, p), tools.SearchIn(ctx, root, p, ig) and tools.CountCandidates(ctx, root, p) with root-path signatures and unchanged results, with SearchIn's ig typed workspace.IgnoreOptions, walking root through a workspace opened at root with those options
criteria.contract: results equal the recorded results; the global excludes file given through the workspace.IgnoreOptions argument is honoured; the signatures compile with root as a string path

setup: a temp tree with ignored and non-ignored matches and results recorded before the change
check.pseudocode: assert SearchIn(ctx, root, p, workspace.NoGlobalExcludes()) == recorded

criteria.action: keep ReferenceOptions, ReferenceSite and ReferenceResult unchanged
criteria.contract: names, types and order of fields equal the recorded lists

setup: the field lists of the three types recorded before the change in the exported-API golden
check.pseudocode: assert fields(ReferenceOptions)==recorded

requirements.title: Old names removed and the package graph enforced
requirements.rationale: Compile errors at every old call site make the migration complete, and workspace must never depend on first-party packages.

criteria.action: declare none of tools.Workspace, tools.NewWorkspace, tools.Walk, tools.WalkOptions, tools.IgnoreOptions, tools.NoGlobalExcludes, tools.Normalize, tools.ErrPathNotAllowed, tools.ErrPathMalformed, tools.ErrNoHome, tools.All, tools.Options.Workspace, tools.Options.Ignore or (*tools.Workspace).References, as a type, alias, variable or forwarding function
criteria.contract: none is found as a type, alias, var, const, func or field; tools.References exists as a plain function

setup: the non-test and test source files of package tools parsed with go/parser
check.pseudocode: for d in decls(tools): assert d.Name !in removed

criteria.action: declare no Ignore field in codesearch.Options
criteria.contract: no field named Ignore exists; MaxFiles, MaxBytes, MaxBuildTime and TempDir remain

setup: the codesearch module
check.pseudocode: _, ok = TypeOf(Options{}).FieldByName("Ignore"); assert !ok

criteria.action: import only standard-library packages and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4 from its non-test files, carrying private copies of the error-tolerant doublestar.Match wrapper and the hidden-name test
criteria.contract: go list -f '{{.Imports}}' over the package's non-test files lists only standard-library paths and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4

setup: package workspace
check.pseudocode: for imp in imports(workspace): assert isStdlib(imp) || imp==doublestar

criteria.condition: a non-test file of package workspace imports a package outside the standard library and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4
criteria.action: fail
criteria.contract: go test failure naming the offending file and import path

setup: a synthetic package directory whose non-test file imports github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/tools, and another whose only offending import is in a _test.go file
check.pseudocode: err = checkWorkspaceImports(dir); assert Contains(err, "bad.go") && Contains(err, ".../tools")

criteria.action: have tools import workspace, keep MatchGlob and ExpandBraces in tools, and have the root agentkit package import neither tools nor workspace in non-test code
criteria.contract: tools imports workspace; tools declares MatchGlob and ExpandBraces; the root agentkit non-test files import neither tools nor workspace

setup: the import lists of the root module's packages
check.pseudocode: assert "workspace" in imports(tools); assert imports(agentkit) ∩ {tools, workspace} == ∅

requirements.title: Every consumer in the repository is migrated
requirements.rationale: The index and the sandbox are built for a workspace too, and the host-agent compatibility contract must survive the rename.

criteria.action: declare New(ws *workspace.Workspace, opts Options) (tools.Index, error) in both index.go and stub_windows.go, and run the build walk and the revalidation walk through ws.Walk with the workspace's rules
criteria.contract: New returns (tools.Index, nil) for a non-nil workspace on both index.go and stub_windows.go builds

setup: a workspace over a temp tree opened with NoGlobalExcludes() and a nested .gitignore, and the Windows stub build target
check.pseudocode: idx, err = codesearch.New(ws, Options{}); assert err==nil; assert files(idx)==walkSet(ws)

criteria.condition: codesearch.New is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return no index
criteria.contract: (nil, the same error text as before this change)

setup: the error text recorded from the pre-change codesearch.New(nil, …)
check.pseudocode: idx, err = New(nil, Options{}); assert idx==nil && err.Error()==recordedText

criteria.action: for any tree, index exactly the set of files that ws.Walk visits from the root with IncludeHidden false
criteria.contract: the indexed file set equals the set of regular files Walk visits

setup: a randomly generated tree with nested .gitignore files, negations, nested repositories, hidden entries and binary-free text files, opened with NoGlobalExcludes()
check.pseudocode: for tree in gen(): idx=New(ws,Options{}); assert indexedFiles(idx)==walkFiles(ws)

criteria.action: type sandbox.LocalDir.Ignore and internal/rsyncx.RuleOptions.Ignore as workspace.IgnoreOptions with unchanged semantics, and make rsyncx's visitFrom walk through workspace.Open and Walk
criteria.contract: both types are github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/workspace.IgnoreOptions (TS-14-1 type string updated); the generated transfer rules exclude exactly what workspace.Walk excludes with those options; the zero-value semantics are unchanged

setup: a host directory with a .gitignore and a global excludes file that only a custom workspace.IgnoreOptions names
check.pseudocode: assert TypeOf(LocalDir{}.Ignore).String()=="workspace.IgnoreOptions"; assert rulesFor(dir,opts) excludes walkExcluded(dir,opts)

criteria.action: build its tool set with tools.For over a workspace opened at its root with workspace.NoGlobalExcludes() and its explicit environment, through a build seam that takes the workspace and the options, and keep NoGlobalExcludes for its rsync rules
criteria.contract: the seam receives a workspace whose Root() is the symlink-resolved R; the workspace ignores nothing from the real global excludes file (NoGlobalExcludes); the tools.Options carry the agent's explicit Env; rsync rules are built with workspace.NoGlobalExcludes(); the default seam is tools.For

setup: an agent with root R and an explicit environment, and its build seam replaced by a recorder taking (ws, tools.Options)
check.pseudocode: a.build = func(ws, o){rec(ws,o); return tools.For(ws,o)}; a.buildSet(); assert rec.ws.Root()==R && rec.o.Env==env

criteria.action: build internal/attach's host tools and internal/fakeagent's tools with tools.For over a throwaway workspace opened with NoGlobalExcludes, and walk internal/treegen through workspace
criteria.contract: hostTools and fakeagent return the eleven built-ins from tools.For; definitions equal the agent's, so digests agree; treegen's walk output equals the pre-change tools.Walk output for the same tree; none of them reads the real global excludes file

setup: the internal/attach, internal/fakeagent and internal/treegen packages
check.pseudocode: assert digests(hostTools()) == digests(fakeagent.Tools()); assert treegenWalk(tree)==recorded

criteria.contract: attach succeeds with no sandbox.ErrToolMismatch

check.pseudocode: sb, err = attach(fake{digests:recorded}); assert err==nil && !Is(err, ErrToolMismatch)

execution_paths.title: An embedder opens a workspace and a model lists files through find_files

steps.action: calls tools.For(ws, tools.Options{}) and receives the eleven built-in tools
calls find_files with a path and a glob
resolves the path with ws.Resolve and walks it with ws.Walk using the workspace's ignore rules
returns the matching non-ignored files and refuses a path outside the root with result code path_not_allowed

setup: a temp project with ignored and non-ignored files and an outside directory
end_state: the result lists the matching non-ignored files only
the outside path returns an error result with code path_not_allowed

execution_paths.title: An embedder builds a code-search index for a workspace and searches through it

steps.action: opens a workspace and calls codesearch.New(ws, codesearch.Options{})
builds its file set by walking the root with ws.Walk
calls tools.For(ws, tools.Options{Index: idx}) and receives the built-ins followed by the index's tools
filters the index's candidate files with ws.Ignored and returns matches only from non-ignored files

setup: a temp project with a nested .gitignore and a text token present in ignored and non-ignored files
end_state: the tool list is the eleven built-ins followed by the index tools
matches come only from non-ignored files
no candidate from an ignored file is returned

execution_paths.title: A host syncs a local directory into a sandbox and attaches to its agent

steps.action: opens a workspace and creates a sandbox with a sandbox.LocalDir whose Ignore is ws.Ignore()
builds transfer rules by walking the directory through workspace.Open and Walk with those options
opens a workspace at its root with workspace.NoGlobalExcludes() and builds its tools with tools.For
builds host tools with tools.For over a throwaway workspace and compares tool digests with the agent's
accepts the agent and exposes its tools to the caller

setup: a host directory with a .gitignore and the local sandbox provider with a real agent binary
end_state: ignored files are not transferred and non-ignored files are
the sandbox's tools are exposed and a read_file call through them returns a synced file

execution_paths.title: An embedder finds the references of a declaration

steps.action: opens a workspace and picks an outline.Decl as the target
loads Go packages and scans candidates through ws.Walk and ws.Ignored with default SymbolOptions bounds
returns a ReferenceResult listing the reference sites

setup: a temp Go module with a declaration used in three places and one use in an ignored directory
end_state: the result lists exactly the three non-ignored reference sites

symbols.name: Match
symbols.notes: Signature taken from the compiling call site in tools/glob.go (globMatch); the module source is outside the repository. workspace carries a private copy of globMatch that treats an error as no match.
